definitions.gloss: to refund; to pay back; to reimburse
definitions.explanation: To return money that was previously paid, such as a refund for a returned product, cancelled ticket, or overpayment. Used in both everyday and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{払|はら}い{戻|もど}した。
⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧{払|はら}い{戻|もど}して⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since it was defective, I got a full refund.

examples.japanese: ⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、⟦{残額|ざんがく}→残額：20756_zangaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{払|はら}い{戻|もど}されます。
examples.english: In the case of cancellation, the remaining balance will be refunded to your account.

notes:
USAGE:
A godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}). The noun form {払|はら}い{戻|もど}し is very common, especially in business and administrative contexts. The passive form {払|はら}い{戻|もど}される is frequently used to describe refunds being processed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧{払|はら}い{戻|もど}す (to refund the full amount)
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{払|はら}い{戻|もど}す (to refund to an account)
- {払|はら}い{戻|もど}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a refund)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返金|へんきん}する→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧: to refund — a more concise, commonly used synonym
- ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to repay — used for loans and debts, not for refunds
